EasyNetBalance embedded Mihomo source
====================================

Upstream repository: https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo
Upstream tag: v1.19.31
Upstream commit: ab405bad5beeeac8b003bb01f60f134f6df54471

This directory is maintained as source in the EasyNetBalance repository. The
weighted-bytes strategy is implemented directly in adapter/outboundgroup and
its controller telemetry/update support is implemented in hub/route. The
source and its dependencies remain under their respective upstream licenses;
see LICENSE and vendor license notices generated by CI.
